title: Giants’ Harrison Bader set for MRI after scooter crash
content:
Harrison Bader’s return to the field for the San Francisco Giants became much more complicated Tuesday, after the club announced he had been involved in a scooter crash over the weekend. The outfielder, who has been out since May 30 with left plantar fasciitis, further injured his foot in the crash, which the Giants said occurred “Saturday night/early Sunday morning.”

Bader was already scheduled to meet with a foot and ankle specialist in Indianapolis on Monday, but that meeting was “complicated” by the crash. The 32-year-old has since returned to San Francisco for further examination.

His injury is the latest blow for a Giants team that has multiple players on the injured list, including Matt Chapman and Jonah Cox. Elsewhere, Casey Schmitt was diagnosed with a left meniscus tear, an injury that will require an extended absence.

This story will be updated.
